description: Integrity Watch — 30 days of daily re-probing for ONE x402 seller host. We re-run the same buyer-path audit every day and alert on drift: grade changes, new payment-breaking defects, or a paywall that went dark. You get a secret watch page (HTML + JSON) and a live badge URL your README can embed. Sold to sellers who already have a live 402 and cannot see it break.
name: akari_integrity_watch
